changelog:
AEGIS (v8.0.3) - Resilience: the fleet no longer dies with the first offline peer.
- [FIX] Three places crashed with a fatal 500 the moment any followed node was offline. The outbound guard refuses any host that does not resolve - which is precisely what an offline peer looks like - so relay_node_curl() returned null and that null was handed straight to the curl functions: radar_sweep.php:48 (curl_getinfo), transmitter.php:303 (curl_multi_remove_handle) and transmitter.php:326 (curl_setopt). The failures were silent: an empty body, no message. One offline ally was enough to kill Radar Sweep, Broadcast and Laser Link. Nine of the twelve call sites already guarded the null; these three did not.
- [FIX] Radar Sweep now gives a silent peer a grace period. A node used to be deleted the first time a single 5-second ping went unanswered, so a reboot, a sleeping host or a brief upstream outage cost the relationship permanently - and the Star Chart silently forgot a peer that was never gone. A node is now purged only after 3 consecutive unanswered sweeps, and any successful ping resets the counter. The Star Chart keeps last_seen and failure_count so it remembers how each peer has been behaving.
- [FIX] Removed a dead pt-0 class from the console and bookmarks containers. terminal.css never defined it, so it was always a no-op; defining it would have pulled those navbars 20px above where direct.php sits. The trap is gone rather than armed.
- [ADD] Continuous integration. The test suite existed with real assertions but nothing ran it; .github/workflows/ci.yml now lints every PHP file and runs all six suites on every push, across PHP 8.1-8.3.
- [ADD] Two regression suites: tests/markup_test.php (nested forms and inert submit buttons - the v8.0.1 bug class) and tests/radar_test.php (unreachable peers and the grace period - the v8.0.3 bug class). Both are built from the real database schema.
- [NOTE] The database path is now overridable through RELAY_DB_FILE so tests never touch the operator's live core memory. Unset, the path is unchanged.
- [NOTE] Run php installer/upgrade_db.php after updating: it adds last_seen and failure_count to following. Idempotent and safe to re-run.
- [NOTE] Carries forward the v8.0 security overhaul and the v8.0.1/v8.0.2 fixes. See RELEASE_NOTES.md for the full history.
